findings.what: (point 2, anchor bookkeeping) Two conclusions of the general paragraph are not in the listed anchors. (a) 'M carries a unique maximal a.e. (G,X)-structure for which π is an a.e. morphism': GX.quotientBase_ruled only gives ∃! B with IsMaximalAEAtlas ∧ IsAEMorphismOf ∧ sing ⊆ π{r=0}, i.e. uniqueness among the B that also satisfy the singular-locus bound; uniqueness among all maximal B making π an a.e. morphism is GX.quotientBase (or quotientBase_ruled together with GX.quotientBase_sing_subset). (b) 'the cylinder can be endowed ... with the maximal a.e. (G,X)-atlas generated by ...' asserts that devAtlas is an a.e. atlas, which is GX.isAEAtlas_devAtlas with the portliness of {r>0} (Quotient.lean:1233), not an anchor. Both are kernel-proved in the row under the rewrite's hypotheses, so this is not an overclaim, but the anchor list does not carry them.
findings.fix: Add GX.quotientBase (or GX.quotientBase_sing_subset) and GX.isAEAtlas_devAtlas to `anchor`.
